name: inkkit
description: Shared device-layer HAL support for freeink-sdk based e-ink firmware (Xteink X4/X3, ESP32-C3): thin, single-source wrappers over the SDK's Storage, GPIO, display and power singletons plus HalFile byte streaming. Extracted from the InkCards and HabitInk firmwares so the SDK-facing idioms live and are verified in one place.
